meta.title: %BRAND% for your browser
meta.description: Fill job application forms from your profile. You check every field and submit each application yourself.

page.title: %BRAND% for your browser
page.intro: Fill job application forms from your profile. You check every field and submit each application yourself.

how.step1: Open an application form on a supported site.
how.step2: Click Fill this form. Fields are filled from your profile and your saved answers.
how.step3: For open questions in English or Chinese, a draft written by AI appears in the side panel. Nothing goes into the form until you choose Use this answer.
how.step4: Check every field, then submit the application yourself. Tell the extension if you did, so your applications list stays right.

page.privacy: On application sites it supports, and on sites you turn it on for, the extension looks for the application form when the page opens. On any other page, it reads the page only when you click the extension. It never submits a form and never presses Next or Submit.
page.facts: Work authorization, sponsorship, salary, years of experience, degrees and similar questions are filled only from answers you saved. AI never writes them.
page.sites: Application forms on {sites}. You can ask for another site from the extension.
page.signedOut: Sign in to check your setup and connect the extension.
page.unavailable: The extension is not available yet.
